work.description: Aquinas's Latin lectura on the Epistle to the Hebrews, conventionally cited by chapter and lectio. The surviving commentary is transmitted through reported textual states; edition and passage records must identify the exact witness and transmission label used. A locus is the prologue or a chapter, optionally with a lectio.
